scope: CPU-free event isolation with unknown DAC states mapped to zero; no full-board or clock qualification
interpretation: The captured release aborts startup while all observed DAC outputs remain zero. Moving that release to an electrically isolated DAC reproduces the same abort; holding that isolated DAC state unchanged completes 150 us. Omitting the release or adding an isolated PWL breakpoint also completes. This isolates the reproducer from board column-drive loading and points to the digital/DAC event path, without establishing a simulator defect or qualifying startup.
